notes: August 2026 cycle BASELINE. Daily DAU lift for the Fenix Android paid acquisition campaign (adjustment code `m`), carried forward from July UNCHANGED so the August baseline isolates the effect of fresher data. The curve file is byte-identical to data-official/2026-07/marketing/marketing_lift_model.total.2026-06-29.parquet; only applies_to_forecast_start moved 2026-07-06 -> 2026-07-28. Built June-anchored: L_july(d) = L_june(d) + (July CSV Total Paid DAU - June CSV Total Paid DAU). Allocation is the per-country share of Fenix Android DAU in a trailing 28-day window ending at training_end_date, frozen for the horizon. IR excluded (no paid spend there; Iran handled natively via the fill). CARRY-FORWARD CAVEATS: (1) training now extends to 2026-07-27, ~4 weeks past the curve's last measured day, so those extra training rows subtract MODELLED lift; (2) the curve ends 2026-12-31 and the applier fills missing dates with 0.0, so the lift drops to zero across 2027 -- pre-existing in July and harmless for the Dec-15 2026 KPI, but wrong if the 2027 horizon is ever read. Expected to be re-measured and swapped this cycle.
